purpose: Authoritative classification of every allowed Hero-Soldier relation source for the shared relation layer.

BASE_SOLDIER_HERO.meaning: Base heroes that can use the normal Soldier.
BASE_SOLDIER_HERO.scope: Normal Soldier only as the direct source record
BASE_SOLDIER_HERO.spBehavior: May be inherited by the explicitly linked SP Soldier through SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.

SP_HERO_REWARD.meaning: Soldiers newly granted to a Hero by SP Hero progression.
SP_HERO_REWARD.scope: The Soldier IDs explicitly listed by the SP Hero record
SP_HERO_REWARD.spBehavior: If the rewarded normal Soldier has an explicitly linked SP form, the relation may be inherited by that SP form through SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.

SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND.meaning: Heroes newly added to the SP Soldier at its second stage.

SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.nativeDirection: normal soldier relation -> linked SP soldier relation
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.meaning: Derived edge created when an explicitly linked SP Soldier inherits an eligible relation from its normal form.
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.provenanceRule: The derived edge must preserve the parent source kind and source record provenance; inheritance must never erase or replace the original source.

SP_FORM_LINK.meaning: Explicit Normal <-> SP Soldier form relationship used to authorize inheritance.

compositionRules: Only DIRECT edge source kinds may originate a Hero-Soldier relation from ConfigData.
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT may create a derived edge only when SP_FORM_LINK exists explicitly.
SecondStageExpandHeroList is an additive list for the SP Soldier and must never be interpreted as the full usable-Hero list.
SP_FORM_LINK is not itself a Hero-Soldier edge and must not increase the edge set without a parent relation to inherit.
An edge may have multiple source/provenance entries when multiple allowed sources independently produce the same heroId-soldierId pair.
Duplicate production of the same heroId-soldierId pair must merge provenance rather than duplicate the canonical edge.
No names, numeric ID offsets, tier, army type, ordering or other inferred patterns may create an edge source.
Any future ConfigData field proposed as a new relation source must be added to a later version of this contract before the shared relation builder may use it.
completion: A-3 is complete when later relation schemas and builders accept only the source kinds defined here and distinguish direct ConfigData provenance from derived SP inheritance.
